cardBody: Eight steps through assigning, reviewing, returning, guidelines, review modes, spot checks, recording missed errors, and adding to the knowledge base.
escHint: Press Esc to end it at any time.
todayBody: Work handed in by AI employees waits here for your review; items with failing checks come first.
reviewBody: “Please check” lists the spots the employee marked and the guidelines it followed; “System checks” are run by the system. You decide to approve or return.
returnBody: When you return work, pick one of three reasons: "It's wrong" sends this kind of work back to "Check everything"; with the other two, the review mode is unchanged.
guidelinesBody: Feedback from a return can be saved as a guideline, and the employee then says which ones it followed when handing in work; you decide whether to adopt a guideline and can retire it at any time.
trustBody: The more it gets right, the less you check; switching to Check marked spots needs your consent and you can take it back at any time.
spotBody: While on Check marked spots, one in every 5 is picked to check everything; if it is wrong, this kind of work goes back to "Check everything".
correctionBody: If you find an error after approving, you can record it. It counts as "It's wrong", stays in the records, and cannot be undone.
flowbackBody: Accepted knowledge base entries and adopted guidelines are added to the knowledge base; the source shows their origin.
